g.title: CLAIM1
g.text: MG has FOUR arrows out (E2, P4 leak, oocytes, VEGF).
FSH dose moves MG — so it moves all four together.

g.title: CLAIM2
g.text: LHEQ has THREE arrows out with different affinities
and different time-integrations. Maturation takes the EDGE,
OHSS takes the AREA. Only the trigger's SHAPE separates them.

g.title: CLAIM3
g.text: Nothing here is told how many follicles grow.
Mono-ovulation and 18-follicle growth are the same equations
with and without an exogenous FSH window.

g.title: CLAIM4
g.text: The 34–38 h retrieval window is the gap between
an autonomous maturation clock and a signal-dependent
rupture integral — not a scheduling convention.
